newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Amoco sells Bulgaria gas stations to Shell.
newsitem.headline: Amoco sells Bulgaria gas stations to Shell.

text.p: Amoco Corp. said Thursday it agreed to sell its gas stations in Bulgaria to the Royal Dutch/Shell Group.

Amoco said in October it would end its petroleum retailing businesses in eastern Europe and sell its gas stations in Bulgaria, Romania and Hungary as part of a policy change aimed at keeping it competitive in the world petroleum market.
Chicago-based Amoco has already sold Amoco Romania Petroleum Products SRL to MOL Hungarian Oil & Gas Co. RT in April and is negotiating the sale of its gas stations in Poland, it said.
"The fact that Shell is buying the petrol stations is to show how serious our investment plans are in Bulgaria," said Kamelia Slaveikova, spokeswoman of Shell Bulgaria.
Apart from the gas stations in Bourgas and Plovdiv, Amoco had two sites in Sofia and another one in the Danube port of Rousse, she said.
Shell has 23 petrol stations in Bulgaria.
Amoco stock rose 75 cents to $90.625 on the New York Stock Exchange.
